Command:
# DES encrypt then decrypt with the same key
# Encrypt input:
# 1
# 0001001000110100010101100111100010011010101111001101111011110001
# 0001001100110100010101110111100110011011101111001101111111110001
# Decrypt input:
# 2
# 1001000010001010011111100010110001110000110010100011011011000011
# 0001001100110100010101110111100110011011101111001101111111110001

Result:
Plaintext recovered: 0001001000110100010101100111100010011010101111001101111011110001

Notes:
Đây là minh chứng round-trip DES (encrypt rồi decrypt) với plaintext mẫu và cùng key.
